Do you know where it is?''"
"''At a private landing field, near the Roalj Temple…property of one of our donors.|Marda Ro and Elecia Zeveron|}} The '''Roalj Temple''' was located on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[moon]] [[Jedha]] in its [[Jedha City|Holy City]]. In [[382 BBY]], the [[prospector]] [[Radicaz Dobbs|Sunshine Dobbs]] landed his [[yacht]], the ''[[Scupper]]'', near the temple at a [[Holy City private landing field|private landing field]] owned by one of the [[Path of the Open Hand]] [[Religion|cult's]] [[Unidentified donor|donors]]. By [[1 BBY]], the [[Phirmism|Phirmist]] [[Guch Ydroma]] visited the Roalj Temple and summoned [[water]] that he sealed into a bottle to be sold within the Holy City. That [[Standard year|year]], the [[city]] was [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[battle station]]. ==Description== The Roalj Temple was located in the [[Jedha City|Holy City]] on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]]''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' [[moon]] [[Jedha]]. ==History== By [[382 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia]]'' dates the events of ''[[The High Republic: Path of Vengeance]]'' to [[382 BBY]]. during the [[High Republic Era]], the Roalj Temple was located near a [[Holy City private landing field|private landing field]] owned by a [[Unidentified donor|donor]] of the [[Path of the Open Hand]] [[Religion|cult]]. That [[Standard year|year]], the Path traveled to Jedha, and the [[prospector]] [[Radicaz Dobbs|Sunshine Dobbs]] landed his [[yacht]], the ''[[Scupper]]'', at the landing field near the Roalj Temple. While on the moon, the group instigated the [[Battle of Jedha]], during which its leader—[[Elecia Zeveron]], who was also known as the [[Mother (title)|Mother]]—became injured. [[File:MardaRoEleciaZeveron-ChroniclesoftheJedi.png|thumb|right|350px|Marda Ro (left) and Elecia Zeveron (right) sought to make their way to a private landing field located near the Roalj Temple during the Battle of Jedha.]] After Zeveron reunited with [[Guide of the Closed Fist|Guide of the Path of the Open Hand]] [[Marda Ro]], the latter asked the Mother where the ''Scupper'' was. When Zeveron informed Ro of its location, the pair set out for the [[starship]] with the Path member [[Bokana Koss]]. As they made their way toward the temple, the Guide mentally lamented that the journey was proving to be a "long trek." Eventually, the three, by then also accompanied by a [[Shrikarai|creature]] known as the [[Great Leveler|Leveler]], reached the ''Scupper'' and left Jedha. By [[1 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' establishes that [[Guch Ydroma]] visited the Roalj Temple prior to the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[1 BBY]]. the [[Phirmism|Phirmist]] [[Guch Ydroma]] visited the temple during a [[desert]] [[pilgrim]]age and used his mystical ability, which he claimed to have been gifted with during his pilgrimage, to summon [[water]]. He then sealed the water in a bottle that he marked with the temple's name. That year, the bottle was among those Ydroma sold within the [[city]] to other believers and those who were thirsty. Also that year, the Holy City was [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[battle station]]. ==Behind the scenes== The Roalj Temple was first mentioned, as the Roalj temple, in the [[2016]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. The capitalization of the "T" in the temple's name was provided in the [[2023]] young-adult novel ''[[The High Republic: Path of Vengeance]]'', written by [[Cavan Scott]] as part of the ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' multimedia project's [[Phase II: Quest of the Jedi|Phase II]].{{HighRepublicReaderGuide}} ==Appearances== *''[[The High Republic: Path of Vengeance]]'' {{Ab|The High Republic: Path of Vengeance (audiobook)}} {{Mo}} {{1stID|Roalj Temple|in book}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' {{1stm}} *''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Templo Roalj |fr=Temple Roalj |pl=Świątynia Roalj }} [[Category:Jedha City locations]] [[Category:Mid Rim structures]] [[Category:Temples]]
